detail.description: What went wrong this time, for a person to read.

instance.description: The request path this occurrence concerns.

next_free.description:
An extension member (RFC 9457, section 3.2), set only on the `slot-full` and `hold-lost`
problems: the start of the next pickup slot with a place free that day, a business time
such as `2026-11-07T10:15:00-07:00`. Absent when nothing later that day is free, and on
every other problem.

title.description: A short summary that does not change between occurrences.

type.description: A URI reference naming the problem type; `about:blank` when the status says it all.
